_comment: Orchestra videos rendered with Blender (see gen-video.sh in the tuning repo). Add an entry per video: `id` is the YouTube ID from the youtu.be/<id> URL. Keep newest first.

videos.title: Allein zu dir, Herr Jesu Christ
videos.blurb: Nine instrument sections — strings, marimba, finger piano, bass, woodwind, brass, bowed strings, melody, and a conductor — rendered separately in Blender and composited into one stage. The notes on screen are the notes in the audio: the animation is driven by the same features array that produced the tuning.
